decisions.structure: CSharp Dictionary/Set allocation paths all reach EmitHeapAllocate under the source function. Native six common emitGrowableDictionaryAllocation call sites already guard null but print only a raw trap because the helper and two bridging APIs do not carry source-owner identity.
decisions.branches: Set constructor, insert growth, removal compaction and reserve; dictionary put growth, reserve and take rebuild; ordinary-function, control-region and entry literal storage. Preserve the checked storage-plan frame branch, original allocation geometry, probe/rehash order, key/value ownership and all allocation-ready predecessor labels.
decisions.logic: Extend the common allocation helper with ownerIndex/context/state and reuse existing emitAllocationGuard. Pass the actual owner explicitly through emitSetRehash and emitDictionaryLiteralStorage and their existing callers. No source identity is reconstructed from SSA names or codegen prefixes. Common labels remain unchanged; remove the duplicated raw fatal branch in favor of the existing diagnostic writer.
decisions.diagnostics: Current CSharp normal5 and ten actual null sites pass first with exact source-function allocation_failed and trap status. The same declaration-site contract covers both dialects without backend SSA constants. A rejected unescaped nested-quote probe was corrected before baseline using an ordinary dictionary index-to-print flow, preserving the outer-string delimiter rules documented in the guide.
